title: Something Enhanced
description: A 1.21.1 modpack with great mods. Roleplay, build cities or fight it out with your friends. Enjoy
body:
**Something Enhanced** is a well-balanced modpack built for players who want a richer Minecraft experience without overwhelming complexity. Whether you enjoy tinkering with machines, building stylish bases, or exploring new gameplay mechanics, this pack enhances classic Minecraft with modern modded flair.

### Features
- Build complex contraptions and automation systems with **Create**, **Immersive Engineering**, and **Mekanism**
- Improve your journey with tools and UI mods like JourneyMap, Jade, and AppleSkin
- Decorate and customize your world using **MrCrayfish’s Furniture**, **Chisel**, and the full suite of **Macaw’s building mods**
- Enjoy smooth performance and quality-of-life upgrades while keeping gameplay fun and intuitive
- Designed for solo and multiplayer adventures with balanced progression and creative possibilities
